name: Heeding the Call
summary: In Darnassus, Mathrengyl Bearwalker calls druids from Teldrassil and beyond to begin their training. An apprentice now faces the path toward mastering the bear aspect.

sections.title: A Summons from the Enclave
sections.body: Novice druids receive a personal summons when their instructors judge them ready for trials. Kal in Dolanaar, Denatharion in Darnassus, and Theridran in Stormwind carry Mathrengyl Bearwalker’s invitation to train. As Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm’s direct assistant, Mathrengyl is one of the night elves’ most respected and knowledgeable mentors. His guidance marks an apprentice as ready for true trials.

sections.title: The Path of the Bear
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker receives candidates on the upper level of Fandral Staghelm’s residence in the Cenarion Enclave. Druids must learn to embody nature’s living creatures, not merely watch them. He tells each candidate that the first great undertaking is to embrace the bear’s strength, endurance, and spirit. The path reaches far beyond Teldrassil, to sacred ancestral grounds.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
aliases: where do i get this quest
faq.answer: Kal in Dolanaar, Denatharion in Darnassus, and Theridran in Stormwind can send you the summons when you are ready.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a senior night elf druid and the direct assistant to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm. He lives in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave and teaches initiates who seek to master animal forms.

faq.q: Where can I find Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker is in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus’s northwest quarter. Look for him on the second floor of the great living tree that is Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm’s sanctuary.

faq.q: What training does this quest lead to?
faq.answer: Reporting to Mathrengyl begins the trial of Bear Form. He sends you across Kalimdor to Moonglade, where you learn the strength of body and heart needed to commune with the Great Bear Spirit.

faq.q: Why can I get this quest in Stormwind?
aliases: can i get this in stormwind
faq.answer: Theridran keeps a night elf sanctuary in Stormwind’s Park to aid Alliance allies. While adventuring across the sea in Elwynn Forest, you can receive Teldrassil’s summons from him.

faq.q: Why is the bear form the first animal aspect taught?
faq.answer: Druids teach the bear aspect first because it embodies resilience, physical power, and the courage to shield nature’s balance from harm. These qualities help you endure dangerous wilderness trials.

angles.text: As a druid, you pass from novice spells of root and wrath toward shapeshifting and learning the spirits of Kalimdor.
As a night elf, you enter Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, where Fandral Staghelm’s circle carries on Kaldorei tradition.
As an Alliance member, you can receive the summons from Theridran in Stormwind. It speaks to growing cooperation between the kaldorei of Teldrassil and their human allies.
